description: This file defines an API route for retrieving validation reports. It uses FastAPI to create an endpoint at /api/v1/validation-runs/{validation_run_id} that authenticates the user via bearer token, accesses the database, and returns a validation report summary or appropriate error responses.

classes.description: FastAPI exception class for HTTP errors.

classes.description: Schema/model for summarizing validation report details, used in responses.

classes.description: Security credentials object for bearer tokens.
